'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**Ten oil workers are killed and another is injured during an ISIL attack on a bus in [[Deir ez-Zor]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/ten-oil-workers-killed-attack-syrias-deir-al-zor-state-news-agency-2021-12-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Solomon Islands unrest]]
**The [[New Zealand Defence Force]] and [[New Zealand Police|Police]] travel to [[Honiara]], [[Solomon Islands]], in order to help stabilize the country and maintain peace after days of rioting, looting and unrest that killed three people. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/457046/new-zealand-joins-regional-effort-to-stablise-solomon-islands (RNZ)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Karnataka]]
*****[[India]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in two foreigners who travelled to [[Karnataka]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/2-omicron-cases-detected-in-india-says-government-2634241 (NDTV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines]]
****The Philippine [[Department of Health (Philippines)|Department of Health]] announces that all adults over the age of 18 years can receive a [[COVID-19 vaccine|booster dose]] at least six months after receiving their second dose or a least three months after receiving their single dose. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/philippines-allows-adults-receive-covid-19-vaccine-booster-shot/ (Rappler)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Singapore]] reports its first cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in two fully vaccinated people, age 44 and 41, who returned from [[Johannesburg]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/health/2-imported-covid-19-cases-in-spore-test-preliminarily-positive-for-omicron-variant (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 5,266 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 457,612. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/south-korea-reports-highest-daily-covid-cases/2436421 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Finland]]
****[[Finland]] reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a person who travelled from [[Sweden]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/finland-discovers-first-case-omicron-variant-coronavirus-2021-12-02/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a man who travelled from [[South Africa]] to [[Crete]]. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1172943/greece-confirms-first-case-of-omicron-coronavirus-variant-in-crete/ (''Ekathimerini'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
****The [[Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency]] approves [[GlaxoSmithKline|GSK]] and Vir Biotechnology's [[sotrovimab]] antibody treatment, after a clinical trial found that the treatment reduced the risk of hospital admission and death by 79% in vulnerable adults if administered within five days of symptoms developing. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/xevudy-covid-treatment-drug-coronavirus-b1968267.html?amp (''The Guardian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Minnesota]]
****[[Minnesota]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant|Omicron variant]] in a person who traveled from [[New York City]]. [https://kstp.com/news/minnesota-department-of-health-confirms-states-first-omicron-variant-case/6319243/ (KSTP-TV)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Algeria–Morocco relations]], [[Morocco–Turkey relations]]
**[[Morocco]] buys six [[Bayraktar TB2]] drones from [[Baykar]] amid rising tensions between Morocco and [[Algeria]]. [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2021/12/345824/morocco-to-acquire-6-more-turkish-bayraktar-tb2-military-drones (Morocco World News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A group of four former Serbian state security officers, including [[Radomir Marković]], are found guilty of the murder of [[Slavko Ćuruvija]]. Two have been sentenced to 20 years in prison, while Marković and the remaining officer will serve a 30-year sentence. [https://balkaninsight.com/2021/12/02/serbia-convicts-state-security-officers-of-journalists-murder-2/ (Balkan Insight)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Australian Parliament House sexual misconduct allegations]]
**[[Alan Tudge]] stands down as [[Minister for Education and Youth]] after [[Prime Minister of Australia|Prime Minister]] [[Scott Morrison]] announced an investigation into domestic abuse allegations against Tudge from a former staffer who claimed that the two were involved in an extramarital affair. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/dec/02/alan-tudges-former-media-advisor-rachelle-miller-alleges-their-affair-was-at-times-abusive (''The Guardian'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2021 Major League Baseball lockout]]
**[[Major League Baseball]] implements a [[lockout (industry)|lockout]] after the [[collective bargaining agreement]] they had with the [[Major League Baseball Players Association]] expired yesterday. This is the league's first labor stoppage since the [[1994–95 Major League Baseball strike|players' strike of 1994 and 1995]]. [https://www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/32761620/mlb-mlbpa-fail-reach-new-labor-agreement-league-issues-lockout-first-1990 (ESPN)]
*[[2021–22 NBA season]]
**In [[basketball]], the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] defeat the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] [[2021–22 Memphis Grizzlies season|152–79]], making it the largest [[Blowout (sports)|blowout]] in the history of the [[National Basketball Association]]. [https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/32774748/memphis-grizzlies-sets-nba-record-beating-oklahoma-city-thunder-73-points (ESPN)]
